results.description:
They've sworn to protect… but never expected to fall in love. Escape into this collection of sweet, clean romances filled with danger, devotion, and happily-ever-afters.

Unhinged

Ten years after escaping a sadistic killer, Hannah thought she'd buried the nightmare for good—until a chilling phone call proves the man who destroyed her life has found her again. As another woman is murdered and the threats grow closer, Hannah is forced to rely on Luke, the only man willing to stand between her and the monster hunting her. But this time, the killer isn't just seeking revenge—he's coming to reclaim what he believes belongs to him.

Unraveled

What starts as an ordinary morning jog becomes a waking nightmare when Audrey discovers a body hidden near the trail. But when more victims begin to surface, she realizes the killings aren't random—and someone has been watching her from the very beginning. As the investigation closes in, Audrey uncovers a terrifying truth: the killer isn't a stranger lurking in the shadows… he's someone dangerously close to home.

Unveiled

What was supposed to be a forgotten Vegas mistake comes roaring back when Jaxon Keller discovers the woman he married—and never legally divorced—has been raising his daughter in secret. Determined to reclaim the time he lost, Jaxon pushes back into Adalyn's life just as she becomes the target of threatening messages and strange accidents. But what starts as fear quickly turns far more dangerous. Because someone will stop at nothing to tear their family apart.

Please note: The Vantage Security Series Box 1 is a clean romantic thriller set with minimal swearing and mild depictions of violence. Enjoy!

Don't miss the rest of the books in the Vantage Security Series!

Unbroken – Aiden and Maya

Unhinged – Lucas and Hannah

Unraveled – Carter and Audrey

Unveiled – Jaxon and Adalyn

Unstable – Roman and Irina

Unburied – Mason and Vivi

Unmasked – Knox and Everleigh
